name: Wildclaw Chakra (Akashic)
body:
You can channel akasha to enhance your combat prowess while wild shaped.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, wild shape class feature.

Benefit(s): You can invest essence into this feat. While wild shaped, you gain an insight bonus on attack rolls made with natural weapons equal to the invested essence.

You gain 1 point of essence.
